desc:
🚪 Welcome to Door Incremental! 🚪

Every door you open pays more Cash, and every floor hides something new and dangerous behind it.

How far can you go? 🔑

How to play:
🚪 Buy doors and push deeper through the halls!
💰 Discover unique ways to upgrade your character!
🔍 Search for rare Doorknobs and hunt shiny Crystal Knobs ✨!
🎣 Fish in the Fishing Moat and grow Herbs in the Greenhouse!
🌳 Expand many different Upgrade Trees!
⚔️ Gear up in the Armory and defeat the bosses guarding each floor!
🔨 Renovate, grow stronger, open more doors
🧪 Drink potions for double Cash, Luck and Keys!

💎 Roblox Premium: +10% Cash
👥 +10% Cash for every friend in your server (up to 5)

👍 Like & Favourite for more updates!

👥 Credits:
@smartegutten
@CreatorBuildful

Heavily inspired by Depth Incremental and Tower Incremental.
